mapper.sql: r.id, r.request_no, r.request_type, r.employee_id, r.target_department_id, r.approval_department_id, r.target_position_id, r.applicant_id, r.source_version_id, r.payload_json, r.status, r.current_node, r.version_no, r.created_at, r.submitted_at, r.completed_at, l.leave_type, l.start_date AS leave_start_date, l.end_date AS leave_end_date, l.reason AS leave_reason, COALESCE(o.hire_date, t.effective_date) AS effective_date, o.contract_type, f.leave_date, f.handover_person, f.handover_status, COALESCE(t.reason, f.reason) AS reason, r.employee_change_applied_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hr_request r LEFT JOIN leave_request_detail l ON l.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN onboarding_detail o ON o.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN transfer_detail t ON t.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN offboarding_detail f ON f.request_id = r.id WHERE r.request_no = #{requestNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO onboarding_detail (request_id, hire_date, contract_type) SELECT id, #{hireDate}, #{contractType} FROM hr_request WHERE request_no = #{requestNo}
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, from_department_id, from_position_id, effective_date, reason FROM transfer_detail WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offboarding_detail WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND handover_status = 'COMPLETED')
mapper.update: UPDATE offboarding_detail SET handover_status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND handover_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE hr_request SET status = #{status}, current_node = #{currentNode}, version_no = #{versionNo}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{versionNo} - 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (request_id, node_code, approver_id, decision, comment, decided_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{nodeCode}, #{approverId}, #{decision}, #{comment}, #{decidedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.request_id, a.node_code, a.approver_id, a.decision, a.comment, a.decided_at, COALESCE(approver_employee.name, u.username) AS approver_name FROM approval_record a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.approver_id LEFT JOIN employee approver_employee ON approver_employee.id = u.employee_id WHERE a.request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY a.decided_at ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT e.employee_no, e.name AS employee_name, e.department_id AS employee_department_id, employee_department.name AS employee_department_name, e.position_id AS employee_position_id, employee_position.name AS employee_position_name, COALESCE(applicant_employee.name, applicant.username) AS applicant_name, approval_department.name AS approval_department_name, target_department.name AS target_department_name, target_position.name AS target_position_name FROM hr_request r JOIN employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department employee_department ON employee_department.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN org_position employee_position ON employee_position.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user applicant ON applicant.id = r.applicant_id LEFT JOIN employee applicant_employee ON applicant_employee.id = applicant.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department approval_department ON approval_department.id = r.approval_department_id LEFT JOIN org_department target_department ON target_department.id = r.target_department_id LEFT JOIN org_position target_position ON target_position.id = r.target_position_id WHERE r.id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id FROM hr_request r LEFT JOIN onboarding_detail o ON o.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN transfer_detail t ON t.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN offboarding_detail f ON f.request_id = r.id WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.employee_change_applied_at IS NULL AND ((r.request_type = 'ONBOARDING' AND o.hire_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore}) OR (r.request_type = 'TRANSFER' AND t.effective_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore}) OR (r.request_type = 'OFFBOARDING' AND f.leave_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore})) ORDER BY COALESCE(o.hire_date, t.effective_date, f.leave_date), r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id FROM hr_request r LEFT JOIN onboarding_detail o ON o.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN transfer_detail t ON t.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN offboarding_detail f ON f.request_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.employee_change_applied_at IS NULL AND ((r.request_type = 'ONBOARDING' AND o.hire_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore}) OR (r.request_type = 'TRANSFER' AND t.effective_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore}) OR (r.request_type = 'OFFBOARDING' AND f.leave_date <= #{effectiveOnOrBefore})) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_request SET employee_change_applied_at = #{appliedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND employee_change_applied_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT l.request_id, r.employee_id, l.effective_from, l.effective_to FROM leave_request_detail l JOIN hr_request r ON r.id = l.request_id WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND l.effective_from IS NOT NULL AND l.effective_to IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}
